name: memory_read
description:
Reads facts from the persistent agent memory store.
Use when: recalling previously stored decisions, preferences, or context at the start of a session.
Scope: local filesystem (~/.config/agentic-store/memory/facts.json). No network access.
Not for: searching memory (use memory_search), reading session logs (use memory_log with mode=read), or restoring a full checkpoint (use memory_restore).

key.description: Specific fact key to retrieve. Omit to list all facts.

category.description: Filter by category. Only applies when key is omitted. Example: 'project'.
